title: Money Add
statement: Implement `solve(left_amount, left_ccy, right_amount, right_ccy)`. Amounts are integers. If the currencies differ, return `error`. Otherwise return `{"amount": sum, "ccy": currency}`. Adding returns a new value. It does not change a frozen record in place.

Return a new dict. There is no input object to mutate.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Frozen money cannot be incremented with += on a field.

editorial: Frozen money cannot be incremented with += on a field. Addition returns a new money value. A currency mismatch is a domain error, not a silent conversion. Integer amounts keep the sum exact.
